subject: 英语
source: 人教版PEP小学英语（三年级起点）教材单元话题整理
original_text:
【核心词汇】forest 森林; river 河; lake 湖; mountain 高山; hill 小山; tree 树; bridge 桥; building 建筑物; village 村庄; house 房子
【重点句型】Is there a ...? 有……吗？ Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. 有。/ 没有。 Are there any ...? 有一些……吗？ Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. 有。/ 没有。 There is/are ... 有……
【A Let's talk】Miss White: Children, let's go to the forest! Zhang Peng: Is there a river in the forest? Miss White: Yes, there is. Chen Jie: Is there a lake? Miss White: No, there isn't.
【Read and write】This is a nature park. There is a high mountain. There is a lake in the park. There is a river and a bridge. There are many trees and flowers. There are some houses in the village. It is beautiful.
key_points: Yes, there is. / No, there isn't. 有。/ 没有。
Are there any ...? 有一些……吗？
Yes, there are. / No, there aren't. 有。/ 没有。
cautions: 只做内容骨架（核心词汇、重点句型、对话与短文范例），不生成老师逐字讲解稿；词汇与句型均依据该 PEP 单元目标语言整理，不得编造教材未出现的单词、语法点或例句。
